from itertools import permutations
import math

def get_sign(p):
    """
    Calculates the sign of a permutation p (represented as a tuple of values).
    The sign is 1 if even, -1 if odd.
    """
    n = len(p)
    inversions = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if p[i] > p[j]:
                inversions += 1
    return 1 if inversions % 2 == 0 else -1

def get_derangements_and_sum_sign(m):
    """
    Calculates E_m = sum_{pi in D_m} sigma(pi)
    """
    if m == 0:
        return 0
    
    elements = range(1, m + 1)
    total_sign_sum = 0
    derangements_count = 0
    
    # Generate all permutations
    for p in permutations(elements):
        # Check if it is a derangement (no fixed points)
        is_derangement = True
        for i in range(m):
            # Note: p[i] is the value at position i+1. Fixed point if p[i] == i+1
            if p[i] == i + 1:
                is_derangement = False
                break
        
        if is_derangement:
            derangements_count += 1
            sign = get_sign(p)
            total_sign_sum += sign
            
    # print(f"m={m}, |D_m|={derangements_count}, E_m={total_sign_sum}")
    return total_sign_sum

results = {}
for m in range(1, 11):
    results[m] = get_derangements_and_sum_sign(m)

print("m, E_m")
for m in range(1, 11):
    print(f"{m}, {results[m]}")
